hero.subtitle: Write real Pine Script v5 strategies, backtest them with realistic fills, and run them live on Hyperliquid — behind automatic risk gates, from a platform that never touches your withdrawal key.

features.title: Everything a real trading desk needs
features.subtitle: No placeholders — every feature below is running in production.

pine.title: Pine Script v5 strategy builder
pine.desc: Write or upload real Pine Script v5 — compiled by our own Lark-based transpiler, not a parameter template.

backtest.title: Realistic backtesting engine
backtest.desc: Fees, slippage, funding, leverage, liquidation, and intrabar stop-loss/take-profit — simulated bar by bar.

paper.title: Paper trading
paper.desc: Run any strategy against live market data with a virtual balance before risking real capital.

live.title: Live execution on Hyperliquid
live.desc: EIP-712 signed orders routed directly to Hyperliquid, with a global kill switch on every account.

risk.title: Automatic risk gates
risk.desc: Daily loss limits, max drawdown, exposure caps, and leverage limits enforced on every trade.

optimizer.title: Strategy optimizer
optimizer.desc: Grid search, walk-forward validation, and Monte Carlo simulation to stress-test your edge before you trust it.

copyTrading.title: Copy trading
copyTrading.desc: Subscribe to a proven signal and mirror its trades on your own exchange account automatically.

telegram.title: Telegram alerts
telegram.desc: Real-time trade fills, errors, and system health delivered straight to your phone.

security.title: Encrypted credential vault
security.desc: AES-256-GCM encrypted, trade-only keys. Your withdrawal key is never stored — anywhere.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: From request to running live, in five steps.

step1.title: Request access
step1.desc: Tell us about yourself — our team sets up a secure investor account for you.

step2.title: Connect your exchange
step2.desc: Link a trade-only Hyperliquid agent key. We never ask for your withdrawal key.

step3.title: Choose or build a strategy
step3.desc: Subscribe to a proven signal, or write your own Pine Script v5 strategy.

step4.title: Backtest & paper trade
step4.desc: Validate performance against historical and live data with zero risk.

step5.title: Go live under risk gates
step5.desc: Deploy for real, protected by automatic daily-loss, drawdown, and exposure limits.

security.title: Security first, always
security.subtitle: The same protections we'd want if it were our own money.

point1.title: Non-custodial by design
point1.desc: Trade-only agent keys only — your withdrawal key never touches our servers.

point2.title: AES-256-GCM encryption
point2.desc: Every credential is encrypted at rest with authenticated encryption.

point3.title: Automatic risk gates
point3.desc: Daily loss limits, drawdown caps, and exposure limits enforced in real time, on every account.

point4.title: Emergency kill switch
point4.desc: Halt all trading and close positions instantly, with one click.
